source_crosschecks.finding: ToolExecutor.execute returns approval_required before dispatch when approval is required and skip_approval is false. This is genuine source-level pre-execution denial semantics, not posthoc journaling.

request_approval persists approval_id plus full tool_input and wait_for_approval polls by id, but execute() has no approval_id/request_digest argument. AgentLoop executes the approved call with skip_approval=True. The same in-memory tool_call is preserved by caller convention, not enforced at the executor boundary.

Current donor ordinary PreToolUse admission is deliberately nonblocking bookkeeping; PostToolUse can synthesize VERIFIED without a PreToolUse row. The historical and current mechanisms therefore contribute complementary but individually insufficient halves of the successor effect contract.

architecture_deltas.delta: Frankenstein 2.0 must combine historical pre-execution deny semantics with current-donor generation/idempotency checks and post-effect hashing/journaling. Neither caller-side skip_approval nor nonblocking stern admission is sufficient canonical effect authority.

EffectDecision is an immutable one-shot capability consumed at the actual executor boundary and bound to invocation_id/tool_use_id + request_digest + generation + causal_event_id + policy_generation + expiry. Missing, stale, mismatched, denied or already-consumed decisions reject execution before state change.

Human approval remains a decision input and UI workflow, but approval_id is not itself canonical authority. It must cause a typed EffectDecision that the executor independently validates and consumes. Approval storage should be redacted/digest-bound rather than persisting unrestricted raw tool_input.

Canonical-main architecture_archaeology and owner-branch frankenstein_architecture_ingest remain separate provenance projections until an explicit migration/dedupe authority binds them. Main-feed bridge packets may be ingested as corroborating evidence without silently aliasing namespaces.

required_triggerword4_tests: DENY decision prevents the actual tool/executor dispatch, not merely journal classification.
ALLOW decision is one-shot and consumed exactly once by the matching invocation_id/tool_use_id.
Request-digest mismatch rejects execution even when an approval/decision exists for the same tool name.
Stale generation, stale policy generation, expired decision and already-consumed decision all fail closed.
Parallel and reverse-order tool completion preserve exact per-invocation request/decision/outcome correlation.
PreToolUse/admission failure followed by observed PostToolUse cannot retroactively mint ALLOW; admission remains UNKNOWN while outcome is recorded independently.
Approval/effect durable records pass a secret fence and do not persist unrestricted raw tool_input by default.

contradictions.resolution: Historical normal AgentLoop can deny before execution, but approved execution is not mechanically bound to approval_id/request bytes at ToolExecutor.execute. Preserve the deny concept; replace binding with executor-consumed typed EffectDecision.

contradictions.resolution_rule: Do not alias architecture_archaeology and frankenstein_architecture_ingest without an explicit migration/dedupe receipt.
